QUOTE: `app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1397` (`archiveChannel`) | If viewable, archive sets `delete_at` locally via `setChannelDeleteAt` and keeps the channel in the sidebar. If not, the user is removed from the channel locally (`removeCurrentUserFromChannel`). | ... `handleChannelDeletedEvent`) | On a channel-deleted event: if not viewable, kick the user out of the current channel (`Events.CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`) and remove membership. If viewable, only the `delete_at` is stored.

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when not viewable, the user is removed from the channel and kicked out of the current channel. When viewable, the channel is kept with `delete_at` set (marked deleted).
